offering_description.value: CarGurus runs an online marketplace where consumers can shop for, finance, and sell cars using vehicle listings, deal ratings, and digital tools. It helps dealerships source, market, and sell vehicles to local and out-of-market buyers.

quotes.quote: CarGurus believes everyone should be in control of their purchase or sale from start to finish. With our unmatched inventory, unbiased vehicle information, and tools for buying, financing, and selling, our consumers find what they’re looking for at the right price, and have more flexibility along the way. CarGurus gives each car a deal rating from great to overpriced and our Best Match sort order helps our consumers find their best deal. Our sort showcases recommended vehicles based on a variety of factors, including shopper engagement, vehicle attributes, photos, and dealer reviews & services.

CarGurus is trusted by tens of thousands of dealers to maximize revenue in an evolving automotive landscape. Powered by our unmatched audience and decades of insights and experience, we partner with our dealer customers to help them source, market, and sell each vehicle at the right price: locally, online, or out-of-market.
